mainEntity.name: How can I improve my barbell lifting technique for squats and deadlifts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving barbell technique requires consistent practice and attention to fundamental principles. For squats, focus on maintaining a strong core, keeping your chest up, and driving through your heels. For deadlifts, emphasize a neutral spine, engaging your lats, and using your legs to initiate the lift. Filming yourself and receiving feedback from an experienced coach can highlight areas for improvement.
